overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows that romantic and marital relationship dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') significantly outperform abstract sadness or family member tributes. Content addressing everyday relationship friction and mutual understanding acts as a major driver for views and engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on husband-wife dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,767 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,674 views) generated 5x to 10x more traffic than generic sad poetry or individual family member videos.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife emotional tension and unsaid marital expectations.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' achieved 385 views, outperforming standard poetic rants.
winning_patterns.action: Use scenarios dealing with ego, compromise, and communication failures in modern relationships.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract sad poetry/shayari without a grounded situation
weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' only managed 17 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract, overly poetic titles; anchor emotions to concrete everyday instances.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic family member appreciation without tension
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है' stalled at 19 and 138 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shift family emotional content from praise-heavy text to realistic household moments.
